title: Asset and Debt
author: Mirabel Quintana
blurb: Edmund Nystrom, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
